about: Every Upwork number that can go stale, in one place. Prose belongs in the reference files; this holds the values they quote. Each entry carries where it came from, how strong that is, and when it was read, so code/facts.py can tell you what to re-measure. source_kind: upwork_docs, upwork_connector, measured_scrape, study, practitioner, unverified.
